messages:
Diego Morales: heads up 4 INV-2026-1123 for NimbusWorks shows a regional "APAC expansion" surcharge added to the platform fee and support billed as Gold even though amendment says Standard. Can ops triage? :globe_with_meridians:

Priya Rao: drop sub id and the invoice snippet? I'll pull catalog and meter.

Diego Morales: subscription NIM-PRIV-77. invoice extract:
```
INV-2026-1123
Customer: NimbusWorks Pte Ltd
Subscription: NIM-PRIV-77
Private Deployment (reserved capacity) - $28,000/year
Platform Fee - $12,000/year
Regional APAC Surcharge - $4,000/year
Support - Gold - $6,000/year
Total Due: $50,000
```
Quoted renewal (amendment 2026-02-28, CRM NIM-510) shows platform fee $8,000, no APAC surcharge, Support = Standard $3,000. Customer says they negotiated free APAC pilot and Standard support.

Billing Bot: invoice INV-2026-1123 generated by billing-service at 2026-07-02T10:12:03Z.

Lina Gomez: initial checks: meter shows a transient APAC region allocation for 35 days during pilot (2026-03-15 -> 2026-04-19) which auto-generated an "APAC surcharge" line. Also support SKU mapping looks like it defaulted to Gold on renewal because the amendment lacked an explicit support_sku field in the contract metadata.

Priya Rao: sales note? Did Sales intend to waive APAC pilot charges?

Diego Morales: Sales (Maya) confirmed waiver in slack DM and there's an outbound email from Sales on 2026-03-14 saying "pilot APAC capacity covered by Redwood". The signed amendment also downgrades support to Standard. I attached both to the CRM.

Oliver (Finance): proposed remediation:
- credit APAC surcharge $4k (pilot waived per Sales)
- correct support line from Gold ($6k) to Standard ($3k) and issue $3k correction credit
- reissue invoice INV-2026-1123-R with line-level credits and attach amendment + sales waiver
Approval note: combined credits = $7k, within Finance self-approval ($25k) for contract corrections.

Maya Patel: approve the credits. I'll forward the sales waiver email to Acct Ops and CC the customer to confirm. :thumbsup:

Priya Rao: will create credit and fix catalog mapping to avoid future auto-defaulting when amendment includes support field but not support_sku metadata. Filing a ticket for engineering to make mapping prefer contract terms over catalog defaults.

Billing Bot: credit CR-2026-713 created for INV-2026-1123 amount $7,000. Reissued invoice INV-2026-1123-R. Memo: "Waive APAC pilot surcharge per Sales; correct support tier to Standard per signed amendment."

Diego Morales: thanks all 4 please confirm customer received the updated invoice and that RevRec will post credit this period.

Oliver (Finance): RevRec notified; posting will be in current month. Closing thread.
